cards.example_en: He squeezed some ketchup onto his plate of chips.
cards.example_zh: 他往那盘薯条上挤了些番茄酱。
cards.explain_zh: 不可数；与浓缩烹饪用的tomato paste不同。

cards.example_en: The office photocopier has run out of paper again.
cards.example_zh: 办公室的复印机又没纸了。
cards.explain_zh: photocopier是机器；photocopy是复印件或复印动作。

cards.example_en: The office photocopier has run out of paper again.
cards.example_zh: 办公室的复印机又没纸了。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We got lost while walking through the old town.
cards.example_zh: 我们在老城区步行时迷路了。
cards.explain_zh: get lost可指迷路；单独用作命令语气粗鲁。

cards.example_en: Without clear guidance, new university students may feel lost when choosing courses that affect their future careers.
cards.example_zh: 缺少明确指导时，大学新生在选择影响未来职业的课程时可能会感到迷茫。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: My sister has a part-time job at a bakery.
cards.example_zh: 我姐姐在一家面包店做兼职。
cards.explain_zh: 可作形容词或副词：a part-time job；work part-time。

cards.example_en: My sister has a part-time job at a bakery.
cards.example_zh: 我姐姐在一家面包店做兼职。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Our hardworking neighbour grows vegetables for the whole street.
cards.example_zh: 我们勤劳的邻居种菜，供整条街的居民享用。
cards.explain_zh: 是形容词；“努力工作”用动词短语work hard。

cards.example_en: Our hotel has an indoor pool beside the gym.
cards.example_zh: 我们酒店的健身房旁边有一个室内游泳池。
cards.explain_zh: indoor作定语；indoors作副词，如stay indoors。

cards.example_en: Is Saturday morning a convenient time for your visit?
cards.example_zh: 你周六上午来方便吗？
cards.explain_zh: 说 It is convenient for me，不说 I am convenient。

cards.example_en: Is Saturday morning a convenient time for your visit?
cards.example_zh: 你周六上午来方便吗？
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: We took the bus downtown to buy new shoes.
cards.example_zh: 我们乘公交车去市中心买新鞋。
cards.explain_zh: 主要用于美式英语；作副词时前面不加to。

cards.example_en: I felt lonely until my neighbour invited me for tea.
cards.example_zh: 我一直觉得孤单，直到邻居邀请我去喝茶。
cards.explain_zh: alone强调独自一人；lonely强调内心孤独。

cards.example_en: Older adults may feel lonely after retirement, so community centres should provide regular opportunities for social interaction.
cards.example_zh: 老年人退休后可能感到孤独，因此社区中心应定期提供社交机会。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The puppy fell asleep inside my empty shoe.
cards.example_zh: 小狗钻进我的空鞋子里睡着了。
cards.explain_zh: 复数为puppies；通常专指幼犬。

cards.example_en: Our Swedish neighbour taught us to bake cinnamon buns.
cards.example_zh: 我们的瑞典邻居教我们烤肉桂卷。
cards.explain_zh: 首字母大写；一位瑞典人用a Swede。

cards.example_en: This vegetable curry tastes wonderful with rice and warm bread.
cards.example_zh: 这道蔬菜咖喱配米饭和热面包非常好吃。
cards.explain_zh: curry常指菜肴；咖喱粉用curry powder。

cards.example_en: This vegetable curry tastes wonderful with rice and warm bread.
cards.example_zh: 这道蔬菜咖喱配米饭和热面包非常好吃。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I put fresh flowers in the vase by the window.
cards.example_zh: 我把鲜花插进窗边的花瓶里。
cards.explain_zh: 英式通常读/vɑːz/；美式常读/veɪs/。

cards.example_en: He used a saw to cut the wooden shelf.
cards.example_zh: 他用锯子切割那块木制搁板。
cards.explain_zh: 表“锯”的过去式为sawed；表“看见”则是see的过去式。

cards.example_en: My trainer showed me how to lift weights safely.
cards.example_zh: 我的教练教我如何安全地举重。
cards.explain_zh: 运动鞋英式常用trainers，美式常用sneakers。

cards.example_en: My divorced uncle lives happily near his children.
cards.example_zh: 我离婚的叔叔住在孩子们附近，生活很幸福。
cards.explain_zh: get divorced表示离婚；脱离某事用divorced from。

cards.example_en: Housing policies should consider the needs of divorced parents who share responsibility for raising children.
cards.example_zh: 住房政策应考虑共同承担育儿责任的离异父母的需求。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Could you explain the meaning of this unusual word?
cards.example_zh: 你能解释一下这个不常见的词是什么意思吗？
cards.explain_zh: 问词义用the meaning of；不要与opinion混淆。

cards.example_en: She twirled the spaghetti around her fork before taking a bite.
cards.example_zh: 她先用叉子卷起意大利细面，再吃了一口。
cards.explain_zh: 不可数名词；一盘用a plate of spaghetti。

cards.example_en: Crush the garlic before adding it to the soup.
cards.example_zh: 先把大蒜压碎，再放进汤里。
cards.explain_zh: 通常不可数；一瓣大蒜用a clove of garlic。

cards.example_en: Our family watched the Olympics together after dinner.
cards.example_zh: 我们全家晚饭后一起观看了奥运会。
cards.explain_zh: 首字母大写，通常与the连用；也称the Olympic Games。

cards.example_en: We had soup and fresh bread for supper.
cards.example_zh: 我们晚饭喝了汤，吃了新鲜面包。
cards.explain_zh: 常指较随意的晚饭，也可指睡前便餐。

cards.example_en: I tried indoor climbing with my sister yesterday.
cards.example_zh: 昨天我和姐姐尝试了室内攀岩。
cards.explain_zh: climb中的b不发音；climbing plants指攀缘植物。

cards.example_en: I tried indoor climbing with my sister yesterday.
cards.example_zh: 昨天我和姐姐尝试了室内攀岩。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: I spread butter on my toast while it was warm.
cards.example_zh: 我趁烤面包片还热着，在上面抹了黄油。
cards.explain_zh: 表示烤面包时不可数；表示一次祝酒时可数。

cards.example_en: We curled up on the couch after dinner.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭后，我们蜷坐在沙发上。
cards.explain_zh: 动词常用be couched in，指以某种措辞表达。

cards.example_en: We curled up on the couch after dinner.
cards.example_zh: 晚饭后，我们蜷坐在沙发上。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Grandpa fell asleep in his armchair beside the window.
cards.example_zh: 爷爷在窗边的扶手椅上睡着了。
cards.explain_zh: 坐在扶手椅里用in；作形容词时置于名词前，常含贬义。

cards.example_en: The firefighter showed us how to use the hose.
cards.example_zh: 那位消防员向我们演示了如何使用消防水带。
cards.explain_zh: firefighter不区分性别，比fireman更通用。

cards.example_en: We walked through the palace gardens before lunch.
cards.example_zh: 午饭前，我们在王宫花园里散了步。
cards.explain_zh: 主要用作名词；palace gardens中作名词定语。

cards.example_en: Healthy eating starts with small changes to your meals.
cards.example_zh: 健康饮食始于对日常餐食的小调整。
cards.explain_zh: eating可作动名词；eat out表示外出就餐。

cards.example_en: Healthy eating starts with small changes to your meals.
cards.example_zh: 健康饮食始于对日常餐食的小调整。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: The storm is moving northeast towards the coastal villages.
cards.example_zh: 暴风雨正向东北方向的沿海村庄移动。
cards.explain_zh: northeast of表示在……东北方；英式也写north-east。

cards.example_en: Investment in rail connections could improve access to employment for communities in the northeast of the country.
cards.example_zh: 投资铁路交通可以为该国东北部的社区居民提供更多就业便利。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: This little plant grew one centimetre in a week.
cards.example_zh: 这株小植物一周长高了一厘米。
cards.explain_zh: 英式拼写centimetre，美式centimeter；缩写cm。

cards.example_en: The painter mixed blue and green on her palette.
cards.example_zh: 画家在调色板上混合蓝色和绿色。
cards.explain_zh: 既可指艺术画家，也可指刷墙的油漆工。

cards.example_en: A yellow balloon floated above the birthday cake.
cards.example_zh: 一只黄色气球飘在生日蛋糕上方。
cards.explain_zh: blow up a balloon指吹气球，不是炸毁气球。

cards.example_en: The puppy looked scared when it heard the thunder.
cards.example_zh: 小狗听到雷声时显得很害怕。
cards.explain_zh: scared形容感到害怕；scary形容令人害怕。

cards.example_en: Students who are scared of making mistakes may avoid speaking during foreign language lessons.
cards.example_zh: 害怕犯错的学生可能会在外语课上避免开口。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0

cards.example_en: Keep the heavy bowls on the lower shelf.
cards.example_zh: 把重碗放在下面那层架子上。
cards.explain_zh: lower作动词通常接宾语；表示物价下降也可不及物。

cards.example_en: We flew a bright kite on the windy beach.
cards.example_zh: 我们在风大的海滩上放了一只色彩鲜艳的风筝。
cards.explain_zh: “放风筝”用 fly a kite，不用 play a kite。

cards.meaning_zh: 建造；建立（过去式及分词）
cards.example_en: We built a small shelter for the garden tools.
cards.example_zh: 我们搭了一个小棚子，用来存放园艺工具。
cards.explain_zh: build的过去式、过去分词均为built，不是builded。

cards.example_en: We stopped for lunch at mid-day beside the river.
cards.example_zh: 中午，我们在河边停下来吃午饭。
cards.explain_zh: 现代英语通常写midday；在正午用at midday。

cards.example_en: We stopped for lunch at mid-day beside the river.
cards.example_zh: 中午，我们在河边停下来吃午饭。
cards.source: Word Atlas collocation and bilingual context CC BY 4.0
